title: Sustainable food upcycling: perspectives on manufacturing challenges and certification requirements for large-scale commercialization
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,648-664
DOI: 10.1039/D4FB00254G, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Arige Nikhil Swaraj, Jeyan Arthur Moses, Loganathan Manickam
Food upcycling turns waste into value but faces input variability, quality, perception, regulations, and cost challenges. Solutions include co-product upcycling, verified supply chains, and tech like automation, blockchain, and IoT. UFA certification boosts credibility.
